candidate: Along the path P-12-2 → TV-12-1 → P-12-3 → P-12-4 → GV-12-3 → P-46-1 → CHV-46-1 → P-48-1 → BV-48-1 → P-48-2 → P-48-3 → CHV-48-2 → P-88-1 → GV-88-1 → CHV-88-1 → P-88-2 → P-88-3 → GV-88-5 → BV-88-4 → E-271-1 → CHV-271-1 → P-271-3 → CHV-271-2 → CHV-271-3 → P-271-4 → BV-271-1 → LV-271-2 → P-375-1 → GV-375-2 → P-375-3 → P-431-2 → CHV-431-1 → P-431-3 → P-519-2, the items with datasheets are: TV-12-1 (Fisher ET: no single max pressure; depends on body material/pressure class, e.g. CL150–CL600 per ASME B16.34, numeric table not given), GV-12-3 (6 bar), CHV-46-1 (Swagelok: up to 6000 psig/413 bar for CH series at 37°C; 3000 psig/206 bar for C series; 1300 psig/89.5 bar for brass 12C/16C), BV-48-1 (Worcester F51/F52: no single value; chart per body group/class/seat material, values not extractable), GV-88-1 (6 bar), CHV-88-1 (same Swagelok ratings as above), GV-88-5 (6 bar), BV-88-4 (same Worcester chart, no single value), CHV-271-1, CHV-271-2, CHV-271-3 (same Swagelok ratings), BV-271-1 (same Worcester chart, no single value), LV-271-2 (Fisher ET: no single value, class-dependent), GV-375-2 (6 bar), and CHV-431-1 (same Swagelok ratings). The lowest maximum allowable pressure is 6 bar, shared by the solenoid valves GV-12-3, GV-88-1, GV-88-5 and GV-375-2 (GEMU 165, PVC housing, 0.5–6 bar gauge). Pumps (P-*) and the heat exchanger E-271-1 have no datasheets, so their ratings are not stated.

Gorman-Rupp pumps P-12-2, P-12-3, P-12-4, P-46-1, P-48-1, P-48-2, P-48-3, P-88-1, P-88-2 and P-88-3: maximum operating pressure 250 psi (1723 kPa) up to 100 °F, with a separate maximum casing pressure of 266 psi. TV-12-1 (Fisher ET globe valve): no single figure; limited by the ASME B16.34 pressure class of the body (with a packing limit of 104 bar / 1500 psig).
